cc:Work.dc:title: householder reflection
cc:Work.dc:description: Invented reflection example on equal coordinate scales. The mirror 2z1 + z2 = 0 bisects the segment joining (3,4) and (-5,0) at (-1,2). Both vectors have length 5.
